WITH patient_labs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.PT,
    (l.IGA - l.IGM) AS iga_igm_diff
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
),
patient_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
  FROM patient_labs
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS overall_mean_iga_igm
  FROM patient_summary
),
patient_with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.ID,
    ps.SEX,
    ps.avg_pt,
    ps.avg_iga_igm_diff,
    ps.avg_iga_igm_diff / oms.overall_mean_iga_igm AS ratio
  FROM patient_summary ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean_stats oms
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff,
  AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
FROM patient_with_ratio
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;
